reviews.text: This is the second time getting a trim for my dog Titan. They are always very friendly. If there was more stars I would give. Very satisfied 10 Stars. :-)

My dog Georgie loves this place to get groomed! They do a phenomenal job everytime. Georgie was booked two weeks out but they were quick to contact us when there was an cancellation/opening. Basically got in the next day which was awesome. I’d recommend this place to any dog owners. Great price for the service they do

Amazing staff, the service is affordable and my dog looked absolutely IG-worthy afterwards. They are attentive to your requests and will listen about your dog's particular needs. My dog enjoyed it so much that he was very eager to go to his second visit.

Very minor criticism is their online calendar, booking, and communications around appointments are very rudimentary. Decent but leaves a little bit to be desired, they are relatively quick to respond to appointment changes, as they had to rebook us last minute as our scheduled groomer had injured his hand. They emailed us right away and asked for a rebook. Quite happy with their service and will continue to use their services.
Friendly service, reasonable prices and overall a very satisfactory experience each time. Definitely recommended!

Update from previous 5 star review

We’ve been taking our yorkiepoo to Ball and Biscuit Grooming for years without any major issues. Unfortunately, after our dog’s longtime favourite groomer left, we began seeing Sophie, and the experience has recently gone downhill.

During his last two grooming appointments, our dog was nipped twice on back-to-back visits. While we understand accidents can happen occasionally, it was concerning that there seemed to be no proper protocol or accountability in place when it happened multiple times. We also were not offered any sort of discount, credit, or meaningful reassurance either time.

What’s most upsetting is the impact this has had on our dog. He is now visibly anxious and afraid to come into the salon, which was never an issue before. A grooming environment should feel safe and stress-free for pets, especially long-term clients who have built trust with the salon over the years.

Management has changed since we first started bringing our dog here and they seriously need to improve how incidents like this are handled, particularly when repeat injuries occur.

February 2026 update: Changed from previous 5/5 star review.

-This business has been sold off and completely changed. The booking website still lets you book groomers who clearly do not work there. I traveled 2 hours thinking my dog was being groomed by the old staff I booked online.

-The new groomer seems nice but does not have experience with anxious dogs. She was surprised by a lot of typical dog language and seemed incredibly apprehensive.

-As with recent reviews, I was told 1.5 hours and it took almost 3 hours. The groom quality was okay, but patches were missed.

-My dog has high needs and previous trauma, so I will be looking elsewhere for an experienced groomer.

-Overall, I am incredibly disappointed. I accepted the 30% cost increase at booking because the website mentions nothing about a new ownership and the last owners were genuinely good dog people.

---------
I've been taking my dog here for awhile and they're always so friendly, communicative, and do a great job with my dog and the grooming quality. He's a fearful rescue but they are able to work well with him. They have great attention to detail and some serious grooming talent.

I’ve been bringing my dog here every 6-8 weeks for the past 4.5 years since he was a puppy. Until yesterday, I trusted this place and felt comfortable leaving my dog in their care. What should have been just another routine grooming has turned into a nightmare.

When I picked him up, he was clearly scared and distressed, shaking and trembling in fear. He couldn’t open his eyes and was squinting hard to keep them closed. They apologized for not sending the usual text saying he was ready for pick up and said they had tried to rinse out his eye. The only reason I even got him when I did was because I decided to just go to the shop to check in thinking they forgot to text me or texted a different family member. They still had the audacity to collect full payment. I took him straight to the vet, where they used a blue light to examine his eyes and confirmed he has scratches in both of them. When we called back afterward, the person who answered was laughing. Whether it was nerves or guilt, it was completely inappropriate given the situation. There was no accountability and no real concern shown for my dog. We then asked to speak to the owner so the groomer had provided their phone number, however, when we attempted to call her it went straight to voicemail and she never returned our call.

Appointments are usually 1.5-2 hours long, but this one was 2.5 hours with no update. Looking back, it feels like time was spent trying to make him seem okay instead of being upfront about what happened. I should have been contacted the moment they realized something was wrong.

They did refund the cost of the grooming and covered the ~$150 Vet visit , but that doesn’t reflect what we’re now dealing with at home. The ointment needs to be applied to his eyes three times a day. He’s now extremely anxious and won’t let us near his face, making something that should be simple, incredibly stressful and we are not even certain the ointment can be applied as our dog resists as he is in so much pain. Not to mention he is forced to wear a cone all day so we can make sure that he doesn’t scratch at his eye. All we can do now is wait and hope for the best.

I’m incredibly disappointed. When it comes to your pet, trust is everything, and that trust has been broken. I will not be going back and will ensure to let others know about this traumatizing experience.
Sophie did a great job grooming our girl!
I was told it would take two hours, but ended up waiting over four. My pup looked okay, but nails were still quite sharp afterward. Staff were polite, but overall not worth what I paid.

My little terrier used to dread grooming, making it a stressful ordeal for both of us, but the team at Ball & Biscuit Grooming is just magical. They were so patient and kind, and I could tell my dog felt safe with them. His puppy groom was perfect, and he actually wagged his tail walking out, which never happens! They truly understand pet temperaments and made a huge difference.
The haircut was fine, but the overall experience seemed stressful for her. It felt rushed, and I didn’t get the sense they took the time to make her comfortable.

I wasn’t satisfied with the service quality. My dog seemed stressed after grooming and had a small nick near the paw. I wish they paid more attention to handling and comfort. Probably won’t return, though I appreciate their effort to follow up afterward.

It breaks my heart to leave a low rating because I know grooming isn’t easy, but my experience wasn’t great. My dog came home looking uneven, and there was still shampoo residue around his ears. He kept scratching afterward, which made me worry. I tried reaching out, but the response felt a bit dismissive. I just wish they showed more care and attention to detail.
Ball & Biscuit always makes my dog look amazing and solves all my shedding woes with their fantastic treatments.

Finding a groomer that truly understands de-shedding for my golden retriever has been a challenge until now. The online booking system was super easy to navigate, and the results were phenomenal; my home is already noticeably cleaner, and my pup feels so much lighter and happier. This place completely resolved our constant fur battles!
My anxious dog had the smoothest bath and brush ever, thanks to the incredibly gentle team here!
Booking online was a breeze and my poodle looks absolutely fabulous after her full groom!
I take my very difficult Chihuahua here for his yearly shave and Ray is able to handle him! Thank you so much

Had been a customer for over 4 years, however ownership has changed recently and there has been a noticeable decrease in the quality of service. Do not recommend.

Edit: We did ask the groomer to fix the issues at our last visit but they didn’t “have any time”

Took our schnauzer puppy here for a lite groom. It was it's first grooming so we were worried but he was well taken care of and we were more than satisfied with finished look. Can definitely recommend and will be returning for sure. Great price, immaculate service, perfect results.
Very happy with the whole process. Everyone was very kind, and Sam seemed to be treated very nicely. Thanks everyone!
Great service, friendly staff! Recommended to everyone who needs the service for their pets.
Very happy with my dogs haircut! 💈😄 He looks fantastic and it is such a sweet relief to no longer have his winter coat shed all over my apartment 🙏🏼 definitely recommend and will be returning 🥰 …
Great groomers. Able to get my guy looking in tip top shape!
Thank you for the 5-star rating! We appreciate your support!

One star unfortunately, as grooming quality was very poor. It didn't look that any work was done on my Nala and Tucker, it was trimming not a full groom. They charged a full price though.  Couldn't talk to person who did the actual grooming, when i asked for her, they said "she is busy and you talk to another girl. She will delivere your message". Its like a factory there.
Also, I requested not to cut around his eyes, but they did it anyway. Probably, forgot to pass my request.
The smell of the products they use is not pleasant. Smells cheap. Plus, they charged me more, saying that took more time then usually!  Really? First time we paid more than agreed upon. Not coming back....
My cockapoo is always so handsome when he's done :) They do great work with wonderful attention to detail.

Thank you to the team at Ball and Biscuit Grooming for making my fur baby so handsome. It was our first time going to them after our previous groomer went out of business, so happy that we found this place.They did such a good job! We will definitely be a returning client. Highly recommend them!
Thank you for your 5-star review! We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you again!
Having been coming for 3 years and they keep getting better! Would highly recommend as they do a great job and don’t take too long!

Five stars for Ball and Biscuit Grooming 🙌🏼
Vader always comes back looking like a handsome little guys ! We have gone here a few times and each time so happy with the service! Ray and the staff are amazing so friendly and great customer service. Thank u very much for taking care of our little guy and making him look adorable 🥰
I can confidently say this is one of the best groomings in town.
Knowledgeable and friendly staff, I am glad I can trust them with proper grooming of my dog.
We are always so happy with our dogs’ grooming here. Great staff, attentive and well priced service.
Thank you so much for your 5-star rating! We truly appreciate your support and look forward to serving you again.

Did a great job again. Dog left happy. Very friendly.
Before and after. Nuff said
Great location, friendly staff, easy drop off and pick up! Best of all our Marmee looks so cute! Thanks for fitting us in :) highly recommended!!!
Excellent service! Patient and friendly staff

Carrie was the previous owner of this salon and she and her staff were great. I never left the salon with any issues about my Pomeranian’s groom. Yes one time the fur around ons of his ears was slightly different than the other, but Carrie admitted this before I paid and it was not a big deal. New owners are below average as far as quality groom services and customer service. It’s like a factory there now. I had an outrageously terrible groom on my Pomeranian and had to wait a week to be able to get it corrected. The head groomer at that time offered no apology for the mess and inconvenience to me.I had already paid a tip.On another occasion she dismissed my concerns about my Pom starting to cough for over a day after her groom. I had enquired about their use of the neck loop on the grooming table.
She started telling me that Poms have a predisposition for honking and coughing and lecturing as if I don’t know my own dog breed. Just insensitive, judgmental and rude.
Also the time management is poor. I was told 1 hour and the last two times I had to wait over two and a half hours and missed my own appointment.Carrie the previous owner was very good at keeping on time.
Also, I don’t like the smell of the products they seem to be using now either.
This business is capitalizing on the previous owner’s quality salon services and are nowhere near as professional . Thankfully I have found a lovely groomer who clearly likes her job and the pets and does an amazing job on my two Poms.

I couldn’t be happier with this grooming service! The team was warm, attentive, and clearly loves what they do. My dog came out looking and smelling amazing—his coat was soft and perfectly trimmed, with thoughtful little touches like a cute bow. The facility was spotless, and the entire experience felt safe and welcoming. Highly recommend for anyone looking for top-notch care and a stress-free grooming experience!
I had an amazing experience with ball and biscuit grooming. Super nice and caring, definitely will go back again. It’s highly recommended.

I can’t say enough good things about Ball and Biscuit Grooming! From the moment I walked in, I could tell my pet was in the best hands. The staff is not only professional but also incredibly warm and attentive to both pets and their owners. …

This was my first time at Ball and Biscuit, and I’m beyond impressed! My dog is usually very nervous around strangers, but the groomers were so patient and gentle with him. He came out looking and smelling great! The whole process was smooth and professional. I will definitely be coming back!
Really solid grooming place, been going there for years and always a fantastic result. Highly recommend.
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! We’re thrilled you had a great experience with us. We look forward to serving you and your furry friend again!
I’ve cut my cat’s nails at many places before and this is my favourite place because as a new cat owner. They gave me the support i need
Friendliest staff and our dog sugar is always happy whenever we pick her up from her appointments. Thank you for your kindness ❤️
Highly recommend! My favourite dog groomer in the city!
